SELECT u.id FROM sys_user u WHERE u.status = 1 AND u.supplier_id IS NULL AND u.customer_id IS NULL
AND u.dept_id IN #{d}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role ro ON ro.id = ur.role_id AND ro.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.role_id IN #{r})
ORDER BY u.id
SELECT notice_id AS "noticeId", COUNT(*) AS "totalCount", COUNT(read_time) AS "readCount" FROM sys_notice_recipient WHERE notice_id IN #{id} GROUP BY notice_id

SELECT r.user_id AS "userId", u.username AS "username", u.nickname AS "nickname", d.name AS "deptName", r.read_time AS "readTime" FROM sys_notice_recipient r JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id WHERE r.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND r.read_time IS NOT NULL AND r.read_time IS NULL
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY r.read_time DESC, r.user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_notice_recipient SET read_time = #{time} WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND read_time IS NULL
